t_176: How long does it take to produce and shoot a commercial or corporate film?
t_177: The duration depends on the scope of work and the volume of scenes; usually, the pre-production and planning phase takes 3 to 7 days, filming takes 1 to 3 days, while final editing and coloring take 5 to 10 working days. We also offer fast production services for urgent events and occasions.
t_178: Does K-Light handle casting actors and obtaining filming permits?
t_179: Yes, entirely! We offer a turnkey production service that includes obtaining all official filming permits from the concerned authorities in the Kingdom, securing locations, auditioning professional actors and models, in addition to licensed drone flight permits.
t_180: What delivery formats and resolutions do we get?
t_181: The final master is delivered in ultra-high resolution up to 8K or 4K ProRes HQ, standard for TV and cinema broadcast, in addition to exporting optimized and tailored copies for social media platforms (16:9 for screens, 9:16 for Reels and TikTok, 1:1 for Instagram), with full usage rights for your company.
t_182: Do you provide filming and event coverage services outside Riyadh?
t_183: Certainly; although our main studios are headquartered in the capital Riyadh, K-Light filming crews and mobile equipment cover all cities and regions of Saudi Arabia (Jeddah, AlUla, Eastern Province, NEOM, Abha, etc.).
t_184: How is the project cost determined and how to get a quote?
t_185: We offer flexible and transparent pricing tailored to the size of your marketing goals. You can contact us directly via WhatsApp or fill out the contact form at the bottom of the page, and our production consultant will discuss your requirements and provide a detailed quote within a few hours.
